```{r helper_functions, include = FALSE}
ifelse_is_docx <- function(docx, others) {
    if (is_docx_output())
        docx
    else
        others
}

.cli_text <- function(...)cli::cli_format_method(cli::cli_text(...))

.boxjitter <- function(lst, cols, ylab, ...) {
    op <- par(mar = c(5, 4.5, 0.5, 0.5))
    set.seed(20260528)
    boxplot(
        lst, col = cols, border = "grey30",
        ylab = ylab, bty = "l", outline = FALSE, ...
    )
    stripchart(
        lst, vertical = TRUE, method = "jitter", jitter = 0.1,
        pch = pt_pch, col = adjustcolor(col_ref, alpha.f = pt_alpha),
        cex = 0.8, add = TRUE
    )
    par(op)
}
```

```{r import, include = FALSE}
n_bottles_per_or      <- 10
sevo_bottle_ml        <- 250
sevo_density_g_per_ml <- 1.52
sevo_g_per_bottle     <- sevo_bottle_ml * sevo_density_g_per_ml
setting <- read.csv(find_git_root_file("raw-data", "setting.csv"))

crf <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(
        list.files(
            find_git_root_file("raw-data", "crfs"),
            pattern = "*\\.csv",
            full.names = TRUE
            ),
        function(x)read.csv(
            x,
            comment.char = "#", na.strings = c("NA", ""), strip.white = TRUE,
            tryLogical = FALSE
        )
    )
)

names(crf)[names(crf) == "balanced.anaesthesia"] <- "inhalational.anaesthesia"

crf$or <- sprintf("%02.f-%02.f", crf$center.id, crf$or.id)
crf$start <- lubridate::ymd_hms(crf$start)
crf$end <- lubridate::ymd_hms(crf$end)

crf <- merge(crf, setting, all = TRUE)

crf$water.trap[is.na(crf$water.trap)] <- 0

weights <- read.csv(find_git_root_file("raw-data", "zeosys", "weights.csv"))

baseline_weights <- local({
    cn <- read.csv(find_git_root_file("raw-data", "weights", "cn-agcs.csv"))
    ch <- read.csv(find_git_root_file("raw-data", "weights", "vct-or-ch-agcs.csv"))
    data.frame(
        type   = c("CN", "CH"),
        n      = c(nrow(cn), nrow(ch)),
        median = c(
            median(cn$initial.weight, na.rm = TRUE),
            median(ch$initial.weight, na.rm = TRUE)
        ),
        iqr = c(
            IQR(cn$initial.weight, na.rm = TRUE),
            IQR(ch$initial.weight, na.rm = TRUE)
        )
    )
})

agc_summary <- function(x) {
    dur_min <- as.double((x$end - x$start), units = "mins")

    cmbs <- expand.grid(
        airway = c("L", "T"),
        laparoscopic = 0:1,
        inhalational.anaesthesia = 0:1
    )

    sel_cmb <- function(x, cmb) {
        x$airway == cmb[["airway"]] &
        x$laparoscopic == cmb[["laparoscopic"]] &
        x$inhalational.anaesthesia == cmb[["inhalational.anaesthesia"]]
    }

    n_cases <- apply(cmbs, MARGIN = 1L, function(cmb)
        sum(sel_cmb(x, cmb), na.rm = TRUE)
    )

    sum_dur <- apply(cmbs, MARGIN = 1L, function(cmb)
        sum(dur_min[sel_cmb(x, cmb)], na.rm = TRUE)
    )

    med_flow <- apply(cmbs, MARGIN = 1L, function(cmb)
        median(x$flow[sel_cmb(x, cmb)], na.rm = TRUE)
    )

    nms <- paste(
        ifelse(cmbs[["airway"]] == "L", "lama", "tube"),
        ifelse(cmbs[["laparoscopic"]], "lap", "nonlap"),
        ifelse(cmbs[["inhalational.anaesthesia"]], "inha", "tiva"),
        sep = "."
    )

    names(n_cases) <- paste("n", "cases", nms, sep = ".")
    names(sum_dur) <- paste("sum", "dur", nms, sep = ".")
    names(med_flow) <- paste("med", "flow", nms, sep = ".")

    c(
        n.cases = nrow(x),
        n_cases,
        sum.dur = sum(dur_min, na.rm = TRUE),
        sum_dur,
        med.flow = matrixStats::weightedMedian(x$flow, dur_min, na.rm = TRUE),
        med_flow,
        pct.tube =mean(x$airway == "T", na.rm = TRUE),
        pct.lap = mean(x$laparoscopic, na.rm = TRUE),
        water.trap = x$water.trap[1L]
    )
}

agcs <- as.data.frame(
    do.call(rbind, lapply(split(crf, crf$agc.id), agc_summary))
)
agcs$agc.id <- rownames(agcs)
rownames(agcs) <- NULL

agcs <- merge(
    agcs, weights[c("agc.id", "weight1", "weight2", "available")],
    all.x = TRUE
)

agcs$weight.diff <- agcs$weight2 - agcs$weight1
agcs$weight.gain <- agcs$weight2 -
    baseline_weights$median[
        match(toupper(substr(agcs$agc.id, 1L, 2L)), baseline_weights$type)
    ]
agcs$center <- crf[["center.id"]][match(agcs$agc.id, crf$agc.id)]
agcs$or <- crf[["or"]][match(agcs$agc.id, crf$agc.id)]

## avg bottles per AGC: proportional share of 10 bottles per OR,
## weighted by med.flow * sum.dur; computed over all AGCs so the
## proportions within each OR are correct before subsetting to final
agcs$avg.bottles <- ave(
    agcs$med.flow * agcs$sum.dur,
    agcs$or,
    FUN = function(w) n_bottles_per_or * w / sum(w, na.rm = TRUE)
)


## exclusion

## exclude OR 09-01 and 09-03 due to poor documentation
agcs$exclusion.reason[agcs$or %in% c("09-01", "09-03")] <-
    "poor documentation"
agcs$excluded <- !is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason)

## exclude due to too few cases
agcs$exclusion.reason[agcs$n.cases < 10 & !agcs$excluded] <-
    "less than 10 cases"
agcs$excluded <- !is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason)

## some agcs were never delivered/found to/at ZeoSys
agcs$exclusion.reason[!agcs$available & !agcs$excluded] <-
    "lost"
agcs$excluded <- !is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason)

## ZeoSys can only process 80 AGCs per batch
## We cluster similar filters by nearest neighbor and drop every AGC not in
## the first cluster as outlier.
## Unfortunately we can't analyse the "outlier" AGCs
clustering_columns <- c(
    "n.cases.lama.nonlap.tiva",
    "n.cases.tube.nonlap.tiva",
    "n.cases.tube.lap.tiva",
    "n.cases.lama.nonlap.inha",
    "n.cases.tube.nonlap.inha",
    "n.cases.tube.lap.inha",
    "sum.dur.lama.nonlap.tiva",
    "sum.dur.tube.nonlap.tiva",
    "sum.dur.tube.lap.tiva",
    "sum.dur.lama.nonlap.inha",
    "sum.dur.tube.nonlap.inha",
    "sum.dur.tube.lap.inha",
    "med.flow.lama.nonlap.tiva",
    "med.flow.tube.nonlap.tiva",
    "med.flow.tube.lap.tiva",
    "med.flow.lama.nonlap.inha",
    "med.flow.tube.nonlap.inha",
    "med.flow.tube.lap.inha",
    "water.trap"
)

clsize <- 80L
clpool <- agcs$available & !agcs$excluded
agcs_cluster <- agcs[clpool, clustering_columns]
agcs_cluster[is.na(agcs_cluster)] <- 0
d <- dist(scale(agcs_cluster), method = "euclidean")
agcs$cluster[clpool] <-
    fixed_size_clustering_nearest_neighbor(d, size = clsize, method = "min")

## ZeoSys can only process 80 canisters, we exclude some based on the prior
## cluster results
agcs$exclusion.reason[is.na(agcs$weight2) & !agcs$excluded] <-
    "outlier"
agcs$excluded <- !is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason)

## Test that all exclude "outlier" AGCs are not in the first cluster
stopifnot(all(
    agcs$cluster[
        !is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason) & agcs$exclusion.reason == "outlier"] > 1L
))

ors <- as.data.frame(
    do.call(rbind, lapply(split(crf, crf$or), function(or)
        c(
          center.id = or$center.id[[1L]],
          or.id = or$or.id[[1L]],
          n.agcs = length(unique(or$agc.id)),
          unlist(agc_summary(or))
        )
    ))
)
or_agcs <- as.matrix(table(agcs$or, agcs$excluded))
colnames(or_agcs) <- paste("n.agcs", c("included", "excluded"), sep = ".")
ors <- cbind(ors, or_agcs)
```


```{r summary, include = FALSE}
final_agc_ids <- agcs$agc.id[is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason)]
final_crf     <- crf[crf$agc.id %in% final_agc_ids, ]

n_center <- c(
    initial = length(unique(crf$center.id)),
    final   = length(unique(final_crf$center.id))
)
n_ors <- c(
    initial = nrow(unique(crf[, c("center.id", "or.id")])),
    final   = nrow(unique(final_crf[, c("center.id", "or.id")]))
)
n_agcs <- c(
    initial = length(unique(crf$agc.id)),
    final   = length(final_agc_ids)
)
n_bottles <- c(
    initial = nrow(unique(crf[, c("center.id", "or.id", "bottle.number")])),
    final   = round(sum(agcs$avg.bottles[is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason)], na.rm = TRUE), 1)
)
n_cases <- c(
    initial = nrow(crf),
    final   = nrow(final_crf)
)
n_cases_inhalational <- sum(final_crf$inhalational.anaesthesia == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
med_flow_inhalational <- median(
    final_crf$flow[final_crf$inhalational.anaesthesia == 1], na.rm = TRUE
)

study_period <- c(min(crf$start, na.rm = TRUE), max(crf$end, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r zeosys-results, include = FALSE}
## ZeoSys batch F0205A results (e-mail 2025-09-09)
zeosys_batch          <- "F0205A"
zeosys_sevo_volume_l  <- 11.1       # L sevoflurane recovered
zeosys_sevo_weight_kg <- 16.872     # kg sevoflurane recovered
zeosys_yield          <- 0.52       # internal yield (fraction)

## total sevoflurane used for the 80 final AGCs
sevo_final_kg    <- n_bottles["final"] * sevo_g_per_bottle / 1000

## recovery rates
recovery_pct_final   <- zeosys_sevo_weight_kg / sevo_final_kg * 100

## exclusion counts for flowchart description
n_excl_lost      <- sum(!is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason) & agcs$exclusion.reason == "lost")
n_excl_outlier   <- sum(!is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason) & agcs$exclusion.reason == "outlier")
n_eligible       <- sum(is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason) | agcs$exclusion.reason == "outlier")

## time between weight measurements at ZeoSys
zeosys_date_weight1    <- as.Date("2025-06-05")
zeosys_date_weight2    <- as.Date("2025-08-01")
zeosys_desorption_date <- as.Date("2025-08-07")
zeosys_storage_days    <- as.integer(zeosys_date_weight2 - zeosys_date_weight1)
## unobserved desorption: last study case to the first weighing at ZeoSys
zeosys_days_studyend_to_weight1 <-
    as.integer(zeosys_date_weight1 - as.Date(study_period[2L]))
zeosys_days_weight1_to_desorption <- as.integer(zeosys_desorption_date - zeosys_date_weight1)
zeosys_days_weight2_to_desorption <- as.integer(zeosys_desorption_date - zeosys_date_weight2)

## weight loss between weight1 and weight2 for final AGCs (weight.diff = weight2 - weight1)
final_mask               <- is.na(agcs$exclusion.reason)
final_wdiff              <- agcs$weight.diff[final_mask]
zeosys_med_wdiff_g       <- median(final_wdiff, na.rm = TRUE)
## same canister set in numerator and denominator: those weighed on both occasions
zeosys_wdiff_pct_of_gain <- abs(zeosys_med_wdiff_g) /
    median(agcs$weight.gain[final_mask][!is.na(final_wdiff)], na.rm = TRUE) * 100
zeosys_total_wloss_g     <- abs(sum(final_wdiff, na.rm = TRUE))

agcs$proportional.recaptured.sevo <-
    (agcs$weight.gain / sum(agcs$weight.gain, na.rm = TRUE)) * (zeosys_sevo_weight_kg * 1000)
```

num_cols   <- vapply(final_agcs, is.numeric, NA)
